definition.name: PageContainer
definition.description: Constrain reading width and responsive gutters without owning business behavior.
definition.purpose: Constrain reading width and responsive gutters without owning business behavior.
definition.requiredData: Children and explicit approved width/spacing constraints; no catalog or commerce data.
definition.interactions: Static presentation; preserve document reading order and parent control focus.
definition.states: Default, long Russian text, narrow viewport and zoom/reflow; no fabricated loading state.
definition.responsive: Maintain readable gutters and heading wrapping without horizontal overflow; exact widths, type scale and display variants require scoped visual review.

definition.implementationNotes: Planning candidate only. No production implementation or visual approval. Read exact approved source records and their unresolved policy IDs before implementation. Variants share presentation only; authorization stays in owning domains.
